what: A repo-linked command that shapes how the work loop runs — a question nexus (fixed question set fired at a variable artifact) plus its charter and proofs.
why: The work loop and its utilities are themselves precipitate of the loop (process artifacts); they need the same intent+proof discipline as any component. Skills are links into the repo, not copies — one source of truth, no sync.

v1.why: Registered 2026-07-29 (ticket skills-ride-the-chokepoint), retiring the chokepoint's honest refusal found at /sail's first real crossing ('no registered workflow for class skill', filed sail edge (d)). The path mirrors code-seam@v1 verbatim — a skill is built, proved by its first real crossing, and learns, exactly like a code-seam — because the class's own invariant already names the shape: 'proved + feeds-back-to-origin-on-failure' needs a PROVE summons to hang on (PROVEME), and 'learns' needs a stage after it (LEARNME) before the rest (PROVED). `skippable_summons: [TICKETME]` is the same one fork the grammar cannot derive on its own (a leaf skill goes THINKME->BUILDME; a parent goes THINKME->TICKETME) — no different for a skill than for a code-seam. PROVE_GATE MAPPING: this class's `prove_gate` (below) is the derivation gate — cairnmap recompiles green — and it maps onto the PROVEME summons: crossing PROVEME is where that gate would fire, exactly as the tester's proof gate fires there for a code-seam. cairnmap ITSELF STAYS THE LABELED IOU IT ALREADY WAS (`prove_gate` text below is unchanged) — this stone registers the WORKFLOW VOCABULARY only, never builds the derivation gate. /CHALLENGE IS A KICK-BACK, NOT A SEVENTH STAGE: the skill prose's own cadence (skills/sail/intention+why.json: 'the skill's own prose sharpens by /challenge like every skill') re-enters an earlier summons on a finding — the grammar already derives back-edges to any earlier summons (PROVEME is the natural re-entry: a challenged skill is re-proved), so no new state is needed for it, same as a code-seam's kick-back.

prove_gate: derivation gate — cairnmap recompiles green: this skill renders from its intention+why.json AND no charter-less command renders. (Currently an IOU: cairnmap not built.)
extra_gates: the cairnmap recompile-gate is the skill class's distinguishing extra gate — a skill does not ship until the help that indexes it is current.
kicks_back_on: cairnmap incomplete (skill missing from the help, or a help entry with no charter) → red → fix the charter at source (the charter is the help).
provenance: first non-trivial node-class exercised; defined 2026-07-15 as the skill roster was built.
